title: How to Recycle Your Christmas Tree!
description:
Now that the holidays are behind us, here’s a friendly reminder to either drop off your tree at one of the City’s 16 drop-off sites, or recycle it in your green bin. 🎄 

First, make sure to remove all décor, lights and stands. Recycling helps reduce the amount of waste going into the landfill. Plus, recycled trees and other organic materials can be converted into high-quality mulch and compost that residents can pick up for free and use to nourish their gardens.

To learn more, visit SDRecyclingWorks.com and select “Events & Workshops.”
#recycleright #sandiego
